LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: Punishing Bird
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: Punishing Bird (O-02-56) is a deceptively tiny TETH songbird.\nShould it breach containment, leave it completely unharmed to peck mildly and depart. Any retaliatory attack splits its belly wide open into a relentless, armored jaw of execution.
